text: Passwords in one place. Notes in another. Tasks, calendar, money, and renewals scattered everywhere.
Meet Deskkeep. Your private workspace, kept local.
Everything you manage, on one desk.
Step one. Your vault. Copy any login, and it clears itself.
Step two. Write notes in Markdown. Import your files in one click.
Step three. Drag tasks across the board, from To Do to done.
Step four. A calendar that stays tidy, with plus N more on busy days.
Step five. Track every payment in, and never miss a renewal.
Plus: search everything with Control K, generate strong passwords, and keep world clocks.
Nothing leaves your computer. No cloud. No account. Works offline.
